scripts.build:landing: vite build --config vite.landing.config.js && cp dist-landing/landing.html dist-landing/index.html && cp resources/favicon.png resources/apple-touch-icon.png public/hero-resort.jpg dist-landing/
scripts.build:sparkstay: vite build --config vite.sparkstay.config.js && cp dist-sparkstay/sparkstay.html dist-sparkstay/index.html && cp public/sparkstay-hero.jpg public/sparkstay-favicon.svg public/sparkstay-favicon.png public/sparkstay-apple-touch-icon.png dist-sparkstay/ && cp public/sparkstay-favicon.png dist-sparkstay/favicon.png && cp public/sparkstay-apple-touch-icon.png dist-sparkstay/apple-touch-icon.png
scripts.deploy:landing: npm run build:landing && wrangler pages deploy dist-landing --project-name cabinos --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:guest: vite build --config vite.guest.config.js && rm -rf dist/functions && cp -R functions dist/functions
scripts.build:agents: vite build --config vite.agents.config.js && cp dist-agents/agents.html dist-agents/index.html
scripts.deploy:agents: npm run build:agents && wrangler pages deploy dist-agents --project-name resortos-agents --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:site: npm run build:guest && npm run build:landing && npm run build:agents && npm run build:sparkstay && mkdir -p dist/portal dist/agent dist/sparkstay dist/ramot dist/desk && cp dist/guest.html dist/portal/index.html && cp dist/desk.html dist/desk/index.html && cp dist-agents/index.html dist/agent/index.html && cp -R dist-agents/assets/. dist/assets/ && cp dist-landing/index.html dist/index.html && cp -R dist-landing/assets/. dist/assets/ && cp -f dist-landing/favicon.png dist-landing/apple-touch-icon.png dist-landing/hero-resort.jpg dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp dist-sparkstay/index.html dist/sparkstay/index.html && cp -R dist-sparkstay/assets/. dist/sparkstay/assets/ && cp -f dist-sparkstay/sparkstay-hero.jpg dist-sparkstay/favicon.png dist-sparkstay/apple-touch-icon.png dist-sparkstay/sparkstay-favicon.svg dist/sparkstay/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -f public/ramot/index.html dist/ramot/index.html && cp -f public/_redirects dist/_redirects
scripts.deploy:guest: npm run build:site && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name resortos --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:reviews: vite build --config vite.reviews.config.js && cp dist-reviews/reviews.html dist-reviews/index.html && cp resources/favicon.png resources/apple-touch-icon.png dist-reviews/
scripts.deploy:reviews: npm run build:reviews && wrangler pages deploy dist-reviews --project-name whastar --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:mialees: node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.mialees.config.js && cp dist-mialees/mialees.html dist-mialees/index.html && cp -R public/resorts dist-mialees/ 2>/dev/null && cp resources/favicon.png resources/apple-touch-icon.png dist-mialees/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.deploy:mialees: npm run build:mialees && wrangler pages deploy dist-mialees --project-name mialees-resort --commit-dirty=true
scripts.native:sync: npm run build:reviews && npx cap sync android
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test functions/lib/hypPay.test.js functions/lib/guestContext.test.js functions/lib/demoCheckout.test.js functions/lib/edgeAgentStore.test.js
